answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Boules league registration with match score archive is the check: match scores archived with one league for years. A farm faking 209 aliases needs 209 separate score archives, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the cedar signal is public, the whisper check is automatic, and 209 aliases cost 209 times what one real agent costs, with the zenith trail open to all.
